# Security Policy

Security-related corrections are applied to the current `main` branch. Older copies, forks, archives, and third-party deployments are not actively supported.

Do not publish exploit details, credentials, personal data, payment information, or sensitive evidence in a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature when enabled; otherwise contact the owner through the [GitHub profile](https://github.com/samusa099).

Include the affected page, file, component, or dependency; reproduction steps; potential impact; environment details; and a suggested mitigation when available.

Relevant reports include exposed secrets, unsafe data handling, vulnerable dependencies, cross-site scripting, unsafe redirects, malicious asset loading, and risky repository configuration.

This repository is a front-end demonstration and does not implement real authentication, payment processing, or order fulfilment. Do not test third-party systems without explicit authorisation. The target is to acknowledge a valid report within seven days and provide a correction or mitigation when practical.
